title: Tiverton Town programme shared data and Canva update policy

primary_sources.league_standings: Southern League authoritative standings feed, via existing league table binding

principle: Match Centre and Programme consume the same verified football facts; do not independently recreate or manually re-key football match data. Canva stores design/layout and editable presentation, not football truth.
workflow: Refresh and inspect the two common data feeds before each programme run.
Use latest confirmed completed fixtures, including midweek and cup matches in their correct competitions.
Use the existing programme binding and current live page ID for each relevant section.
Compare proposed values to live Canva and saved baseline; preserve known corrections and manual edits.

Update only allowed editable fields inside page's approved content area; retain Antonio, yellow/white alternating rows, opponent crests, red Tivvy score goals, cards/substitution indicators and all artwork.
Never invent scores, lineup events or unavailable data; mark scheduled/unverified games pending.
Review or flag conflicting feed results. Data refresh is distinct from Canva publish/commit.
For match-adding native table pages, retain editability and layout; if Canva connector cannot extend a table, report blocker rather than claiming completion.

league_so_far.rule: populate league-only completed fixtures chronologically, with full match events; pending fixture can be staged but does not overwrite completed row

results_matrix.rule: update verified league result cells and preserve existing native grid

league_table.rule: refresh standings, promotion bands and Tivvy highlight

tivvy_glance.rule: update verified match and player stats, form, league position

player_stats.rule: refresh verified appearances, goals and minutes

today_in_60.rule: four approved boxes and badge styling; use current fixture data
